response.sql: WITH channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE o.orderbase IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM channel_rates) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.benchmark_rate) AS mean_excess FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Orders with a missing orderbase do not constitute a channel. If no channel exceeds the benchmark, the single result row contains NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat a missing orderbase as its own channel when calculating the benchmark and qualifying channels.
